preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 20 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each test case has n between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**5 <= int(a) <= 10**5 for a in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()][0])
preconditions.description: Each integer a_i in the input sequence is between -10^5 and 10^5 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() in ['YES', 'NO'] for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.
Each output line has exactly 3 characters ('YES' or 'NO').

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.splitlines()) == t + 1 and len(stdout.splitlines()[0]) == 0 for _ in range(t))
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines of answers, one per test case.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line == 'YES') == any(all(any((a_i == b_j - b_k) for b_j in b) for b_k in b) for a_i in a) for stdout_line, a in zip(stdout.splitlines()[1:], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if and only if there exists a sequence b of length n such that every a_i can be expressed as b_j - b_k for some j and k.
